question: In which of the following year the ruler of Iran, Nadir Shah, sacked and plundered the city of Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1739**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **Nadir Shah**, the ruler of Iran, invaded India in **1739** and sacked the city of **Delhi**, causing immense destruction and looting.

• He defeated the Mughal Emperor **Mohammed Shah** in the **Battle of Karnal** on **24 February 1739**, paving the way for his entry into Delhi.

• Nadir Shah’s forces plundered Delhi and carried away immense wealth, including the famous **Koh-i-Noor diamond** and **Peacock Throne**.
